author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Did The Bone Temple properly conclude the story of 28 Years Later? Was Starfleet Academy the disaster we all expected? And can Sophie Turner finally act... not act as Lara Croft, just act in general? Join me, MauLer, Greg Owen, Az and Erin Underwood as we find out. 

Subscribe to Az: https://www.youtube.com/@HeelvsBabyface
Subscribe to Greg: https://www.youtube.com/@gregowen2022
Subscribe to Erin: https://www.youtube.com/@ErinUnderwood
title: Open Bar #171 - Bone Temple, Golden Globes, Starfleet Academy, Lara Croft First Look
